name: Big Five Personality Inventory (OCEAN / NEO-PI-R)
description: Measures the five fundamental personality dimensions: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. Most empirically validated personality model; many free versions (IPIP) available.
reputation: Most empirically validated personality model; referenced in thousands of studies; free IPIP version widely available.
notes: Self-report susceptible to faking; IPIP free variants less validated than commercial NEO-PI-R.
